rows.title: Never hype
rows.reason: “OMG” breaks VOICE-02: Velvra never hypes. No slang superlatives, no shouting, no runs of exclamation marks. The rule's own don't-example is “OMG this is insane!!!”. AI judgment agrees (confidence 0.86).

resolution.reason: Launch-day post, playful tone agreed with the brand lead

rows.title: Logo is too small
rows.reason: The logo is 96 px wide, below the 120 px minimum (VIS-03). Measured from the logo box marked by hand; automatic logo detection is planned for Round 3.

fix.replacement: Scale the logo to at least 120 px wide.
fix.label: Resize the logo

rows.title: Use the product name
rows.reason: Use “Daily Shield SPF 50”, not “sunblock” (TERM-04). Use the product name.

rows.title: Unsupported superlative
rows.reason: “The best serum in India” has no supporting fact in the Claim Ledger (CLAIM-03). Also TERM-03: Use “sunscreen”, not “serum” (TERM-03). Daily Shield is a sunscreen.

resolution.reason: Claim and wording approved

rows.title: Image alt text is missing
rows.reason: The creative has no alt text, so screen-reader users miss it (A11Y-04).

fix.replacement: Describe the image in one sentence, including any text in it.
fix.label: Write alt text

rows.title: Low text contrast
rows.reason: Text contrast is 1.7:1 (#FFB2D1 on #F96699), below the 3:1 WCAG AA minimum for large text (A11Y-01).

fix.replacement: Use Ink #1F1B24 for this text (6:1 on this background).
fix.label: Change the text colour

rows.quote: clinically proven to erase dark spots in just 7 days
rows.title: Claim contradicts an approved fact
rows.reason: “7 days” doesn't match F-112, which says 4 weeks. “Clinically proven” is not approved wording, because F-112 is an in-house study, not a clinical trial. Also MSG-02: Skin changes take weeks. Never promise instant, overnight or vanishing results.

fix.replacement: shown in our 4-week study to help skin look more even (82% saw a visibly more even skin tone)*
fix.label: Use the approved wording from F-112

resolution.reason: Claim and wording approved

rows.title: Colour is off palette
rows.reason: #F86598 is ΔE 18 from the nearest brand colour, Rose Clay #C98B7F. The limit is 10 (VIS-01).

dos: Daily Shield sits light on skin, so it is easy to wear every morning.
rules.title: Calm, expert, warm
rules.text: Write like a dermatologist friend: calm, specific and warm. Explain, don't shout.

dos: Meet Daily Shield SPF 50, made for everyday protection.
rules.title: Never hype
rules.text: Velvra never hypes. No slang superlatives, no shouting, no runs of exclamation marks.

dos: Care for skin that sees the sun every day.
rules.title: No fear-based beauty language
rules.text: Never make people feel bad about their skin. Talk about care, not flaws.

dos: Daily protection that helps skin look visibly more even.
rules.title: Tie launches to the pillars
rules.text: Launch messages should connect to our pillars where it makes sense.

dos: With daily use, skin can look more even over a few weeks.

replacements.instant results: results that build with daily use

rules.title: No instant-results promises
rules.text: Skin changes take weeks. Never promise instant, overnight or vanishing results.

rules.title: Skincare is one word
rules.text: Write “skincare”, not “skin care”.

rules.title: No “chemical-free”
rules.text: Everything is a chemical. Name what the product is free from instead.

rules.title: Daily Shield is a sunscreen
rules.text: Daily Shield is a sunscreen. Never call it a serum or a moisturiser.

rules.title: Use the product name
rules.text: Use “Daily Shield SPF 50”, not “sunblock” or “sun cream”.

rules.title: No fairness language
rules.text: “Fair”, “fairness”, “whitening” and “lightening” are banned. Say “even tone”.

rules.title: Claims must match the Claim Ledger
rules.text: Any study or numeric claim must match an approved Claim Ledger fact and use its approved wording. “Clinically proven” is allowed only for clinical facts.

replacements.results guaranteed: results that build with daily use
replacements.guaranteed results: results that build with daily use
replacements.permanent results: results that build with daily use

rules.title: No guarantees
rules.text: Never guarantee results or promise anything permanent.

rules.title: Superlatives need a fact
rules.text: Superlatives and comparisons (“best”, “No. 1”, “better than”) need an approved Claim Ledger fact.

rules.title: No medical claims
rules.text: Velvra is cosmetic. Never say a product cures, treats or heals a condition.

rules.title: Study claims need a footnote
rules.text: Every study claim carries a footnote with the study type, size and year.

rules.title: SPF reapply disclaimer
rules.text: Email and website copy that mentions SPF must include the reapply disclaimer.
rules.fixTemplate: Reapply every 2 hours, and after swimming or sweating.

rules.title: Text contrast
rules.text: Text needs a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text (WCAG 2.2 AA).

rules.title: Descriptive link text
rules.text: Link text says where it goes. Never “click here” or “read more”.

rules.title: Readable for the channel
rules.text: Copy meets the readability target for its channel (Flesch reading ease).

rules.title: Images need alt text
rules.text: Every image needs alt text that describes it.

rules.title: Hashtags, emoji and capitals
rules.text: Use CamelCase hashtags so screen readers read them as words. Keep emoji and ALL-CAPS words within the channel limit.

rules.title: Stay on palette
rules.text: Dominant colours stay within ΔE2000 10 of a brand palette colour.

rules.title: Logo size
rules.text: The logo is at least 120 px wide, with clear space of half its height on every side.

facts.statement: 4-week in-house study, n=40, 2025: 82% saw a visibly more even skin tone.
facts.approvedWording: In our 4-week study, 82% saw a visibly more even skin tone
facts.inlineWording: shown in our 4-week study to help skin look more even (82% saw a visibly more even skin tone)

Read the full study summary on our website. #DailyProtection #VelvraLab

*In-house study, 40 participants, 2025.
